Let's start with the following important property. 

*The determinant of the product of two square matrices is equal to the product of the determinants.*

Symbolically, if ![](images/34/34058a2a5d1de088feed7d9825ba218394c9a8bb880b046be7b47307cdd37ce1.svg) and ![](images/25/256531b7f0ddb14dd11a59a3019a3361f1607d3fe16fa6d530a461344de8f39e.svg) are both square matrices, then

![](images/e5/e59b47ca5462a066093945e2698404e595a92e9e70a2b8c4f8b2f30df9c9fbf1.svg)

For instance, suppose that we want to find the determinant of the matrix ![](images/32/3207697e43e4f88223ad85c16964c3103a50c0c999a4ca14417695158d45526b.svg) that is defined as follows:
![](images/9a/9a705ea4bd482cdf83251288108b48ff5bc7354c9d51c1b710b9e734c8a32dea.svg)
